23 Pilgrims Injured in Jammu and Kashmir Bus Accident

A minibus carrying pilgrims to the Sukrala Mata temple in Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir, fell into a gorge. Officials stated the driver lost control of the vehicle. At least 23 pilgrims sustained injuries in the incident.
